## Approved plan task C2

- **Functional scope/files:** existing People identity path, Engine role API and minimal Engine-owned composition of resolved Person, trusted widget conversation/config/transcript binding, initialization and `Conversations.list_canonical_messages/3`. Reuse TranscriptHistory permission/scope/projection/pagination. Extend the explicit widget path without treating provider `:web` as trusted BO identity. Keep widget authentication mechanisms, event names and topics outside Engine.
- **Contract:** adapter-verified external `sender_id` and server-resolved config scope enter ZAQ's trusted integration; shared People resolution supplies the canonical Person for domain execution. Use the same resolved identity for init/history/message association; reject conflicting payload sender claims. Authorize each operation and revalidate conversation scope. Unknown and inaccessible conversations have a non-enumerating public error. No browser-supplied owner, actor or bypass is trusted, and no additional ZAQ bearer is required.
- **History/context composition:** private Person/widget/chat binding with Direct participant grants. Init creates no conversation, transcript or message. The adapter retains optional `prompt_context` until the first actual question. Reuse existing Engine add-message persistence and canonical capture to insert it as the first ordinary user message immediately before that question, without separate Agent execution; do not add a seeding subsystem. Seed only on first-message creation, never resume. Retain ordinary title generation, including seed-generated titles. Test ordering, authorized visibility, first-question context, no generated reply and creation/seed failure rollback.
- **Action prerequisite:** only if existing public APIs cannot compose the selected initialization/binding operation, create a focused Action issue with schemas, validated execution, errors and transaction semantics before C3. Canonical history already exists; a new read/permission/pagination engine is not a prerequisite. Context APIs retain persistence and canonical reader authorization; the Engine facade validates resolved identity and scope, not external authentication proofs. Code/transport consumers are in scope; agent registry exposure is not.
- **Tests before implementation:** extend canonical history/scoped persistence coverage: permitted/denied/inactive Person, external sender mapping, same sender ID under different widget configs, foreign widget/config, missing trusted identity, payload sender mismatch, disabled config, deleted conversation/transcript, forged BO capability, reader cursor/limit behavior, creation failure and message-to-transcript association. Cover legacy transcript rejection and private execution-field exclusion; property-test trusted binding across generated IDs. External credential expiry/revocation tests belong to the adapter.
- **Branches:** all accepted principal types from C1 and every rejection path; nil person never grants elevated access. Revalidate resumed IDs before pipeline persistence, not only during widget initialization.
- **Mocking:** real People/Engine/Repo boundaries; fixture adapter supplies verified identity at the actual trusted integration seam. Do not invent a ZAQ authentication service or fake proof verifier.
- **Documentation:** Engine service contract and permission/ownership rules, linked from Channels.
- **Action reuse:** reuse canonical reader authorization/projection, scoped persistence, history strategy and identity resolution; implement only missing authenticated binding/initialization and role dispatch. Record inputs, outputs, errors, side effects and retry policy. No broad Accounts.History recall or super-admin `list_admin` shortcut for widget reads.
- **Done:** widget history reaches the existing authorized canonical reader through NodeRouter with a verified Person and trusted transcript binding; initialization/send cannot use an unscoped fallback to access a foreign conversation. BO restoration stays behaviorally unchanged.

## Execution requirements
Branch: refactor/webbridge. Source: GitHub www-zaq-ai/zaq#830. Read AGENTS.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, and applicable service guides before implementation. Shared contracts, module responsibilities, reuse evidence, decisions and regression obligations are in parent zaq-pkd. Write specified immediate tests first; use real internal boundaries and mock only external edges. Preserve canonical-history authorization, config-scoped delivery and Engine admission/finalization. New/substantially rewritten feature E2E must wait for B3 human approval. Inbound message.edit is excluded; outbound streaming edits remain included.


## Sequencing
Blocked by zaq-pkd.9 (C1).
Blocks zaq-pkd.11 (C3).
Human BO approval: zaq-pkd.7. Persistent consolidated E2E/regression issue: zaq-pkd.8. Widget decision gate: zaq-pkd.9.

comments.text: Latest user correction supersedes eager-init scope: widget.init validates configuration/sender/readiness and optionally authorizes resume, creating no conversation or transcript. First message triggers lazy creation via existing Engine admission. Optional prompt_context is an ordinary first user history message persisted immediately before the real question using existing add_message semantics; no separate Agent run, no new context type or title-generation distinction. Context can generate the title, explicitly approved. Empty-transcript prerequisite zaq-pkd.10.1 withdrawn and dependency removed. Documentation must describe implemented behavior only; decisions remain in Beadwork until implementation passes. Continue with existing uncommitted changes and no Git mutations until authorized. Source audit: web is globally BO-special-cased in identity/routing; native web_widget provider/Person channel is the clean channel-scoped identity path and preserves BO without generic modules inspecting opaque widget keys. Verify and test existing channel resolution/canonical capture before exposing widget contract.

C2 work remains uncommitted. Implemented connector-scoped web_widget identity/config support, trusted Context sender/config fields, shared Message prompt_context, lazy readiness/resume/history and first-question preparation through Engine channel_conversations action, WebBridge role-boundary wiring, and implemented-behavior service documentation. Init creates no conversation/transcript/message. Canonical Direct grants and literal Person/config ownership gate resume/history. Seed uses ordinary add_message plus canonical capture, no separate Agent execution. Validation after nil widget actor wiring: mix q PASS; isolated BO/WebBridge/Engine/history/config/Person regression suites PASS (380 tests, 4 properties); git diff --check PASS. A nil-actor error-order regression was fixed by validating forbidden widget options before actor capabilities, without weakening the assertion. C2 remains in_progress pending self-review/reconciliation and additional lifecycle coverage; C3/C4 runtime/response receipts/sync timeout remain pending. No commit or push performed; final precommit/coverage gate not yet due.

Additional lifecycle coverage now passes: deleted transcript/conversation fail closed without replacement, failed canonical seed capture rolls back conversation/seed/transcript, resume restores stored native coordinates and ignores reseeding (19 tests plus 1 property). Approved scratch plan reconciled to lazy init and first-message creation receipt/title semantics. Validation blocker: mix q now repeatedly exits in ExDNA 1.5.4 Task.Supervised.stream(5000), including normal and scheduler-limited runs; no checks disabled or dependency edits made. C2 remains open until gate succeeds. Continue reviewing response projection on the same integration boundary; no Git mutations authorized.

Validation-tool timeout resolved without disabling checks: ERL_FLAGS='+S 2:2' mix q PASS (18494 mods/funs). Focused new-domain/WebBridge suite PASS: 27 tests and 1 property, including private widget final projection. Wider combined suite had an MCP readiness failure (client_not_ready in pre-existing BO tool-call test); targeted retry interrupted by server restart and is being recovered from logs/restarted only where incomplete. Scratch plan reconciled to lazy readiness and first-message receipts. No commits/pushes. Remaining gate is successful relevant regression validation, then C3 lifecycle/conformance and C4 runtime.

C2 validation complete: current mix q PASS; focused shared ingress/widget identity/history regression set PASS (56 tests, 3 properties), including real sync/async NodeRouter/Agent/Repo/external-HTTP conformance and full assistant canonical-history recovery. Prior Engine/config/canonical regression group PASS 242 tests plus 2 properties. BO MCP timeout case that failed under resource contention now PASS in final targeted default-scheduler retry (1 test, 95 excluded); no assertions or MCP production code changed. Scratch plan and C2/C3 descriptions reconciled with lazy init while preserving execution/sequencing sections. Action reuse: People connector-scoped identity, existing conversation/add_message/admission/finalization, Facts/Direct capture, canonical authorized reader and HistoryDelivery; new Engine facade only composes trusted private binding. Source remains uncommitted, final broader review/coverage/precommit still pending.
